title: China Is Banning Tesla-Style Door Handles. Here's Why #shorts

scenes.text: After a crash, could anyone open your car door? In some EVs, maybe not.
Many EVs hide flush door handles that pop out on electric power, a look Tesla made famous.
But if a crash or fire cuts the power, they may not move. In twenty twenty-five, bystanders couldn't open a burning Xiaomi SU7.
In America, regulators are probing a hundred seventy-four thousand Model Ys after parents couldn't reach kids inside.
So China is the first country to ban hidden handles. From twenty twenty-seven, new models need mechanical releases that work without power.
Most EVs hide a manual release inside. Find yours today.
Sleek design, or safety risk? Should America ban them too? Follow EV Drive.
